fetch_queue.model: One serial cached queue shared by all 50 hunters; GT 13s, RPC 1.1s minimum spacing; stop host on HTTP 429.

limits: All 50 named hunters execute distinct chain/liquidity/hold slices over one serial cached fetch queue. They are deterministic research workers, not 50 LLM models.
Recent trending-pool swaps are sampled and incomplete; no full wallet, full-chain or multi-month history is established. RPC origin checks are bounded.
Source-wallet FIFO P&L is observed matched quantities before fees, transfers and missing inventory. It is not total-account P&L.

Copy replay uses chronological observed prices: 60s entry delay, first net +35% sampled exit or source sell/one-week timeout, finite $500 balance, modeled each-side fees and slippage. Sparse ticks and retrospective wallet selection introduce bias.

Copy-capture rates use best sampled opportunities and are not the paper replay return. Expected daily profit and capital required remain insufficient data. $300/day from $500 requires 60% per day; no evidence supports it here.
Historical entry market cap, true peak, executable depth and complete price paths are unknown. 3x means +200%. No claim of insider status or guaranteed copying profit.
Clusters are within each chain only. No unproven cross-chain ownership linkage is made. RPC funding samples and timing heuristics are incomplete.

Robinhood mainnet verified from official docs and RPC chainId 4663; provider network id robinhood. GMGN Robinhood support is unverified, so only the official explorer is linked. No Ethereum-mainnet data is requested.
Learning is evidence-backed simulated-loss review and suggestion-only. It never auto-changes thresholds. All charts show actual observed/replayed data, not synthetic historical returns.
Public API rate limits and hourly polling miss activity. Modeled fees differ from actual tax/gas/depth. Free sampled data cannot establish expected returns or the capital needed for $300/day.
